title: Autoscale Policy Generator and Throughput Commitment Handshake
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Summary:
Design and deliver an Autoscale Policy Generator (APG) and a Coupled Throughput Commitment Handshake that together simplify dedicated capacity reservations and reduce disputes during onboarding. The APG will produce policy presets and a compact policy DSL based on historical traffic profiles, while the handshake formalizes how throughput guarantees are negotiated, recorded, and enforced across Dedicated fleets and the invoice/commitment model.

Background and motivation:
- Customers repeatedly ask for example autoscale policies that match common workload shapes (steady, bursty, seasonal).
- Sales and capacity ops report long back-and-forths negotiating throughput windows and ramp cadence; friction increases time-to-provision and drives errors in fleet allocations.
- Engineering needs a machine-readable policy that can be validated, simulated against historical traces, and converted into runtime constraints (min pool size, burst credit, cooldowns).

Goals and success metrics:
- Reduce average dedicated onboarding time from contract signature to first-provision by 35%.
- 90% of new reservations use an APG template within two weeks of launch.
- Zero customer-facing SLA violations attributable to misconfigured autoscale policies in first 3 months after rollout.
- Provide simulation results (predicted p95 latency, expected cost delta) for every suggested policy.

Proposed solution overview:
1) Autoscale Policy Generator (APG) service and Console UX
   - Input: historical request rate and token distribution (optional sample), desired latency SLO or cost target.
   - Output: 3 suggested policy presets: Latency-First, Cost-First, Balanced. Each preset includes: min_reserved_units, burst_window (tokens/min and time), cooldown_seconds, kv-cache hints, and recommended quantization profile when applicable.
   - Policy DSL: a compact JSON/YAML schema that maps to runtime knobs. The DSL will include validation rules and backward-compatibility mapping to existing runtime config keys.
   - Console: onboarding wizard with an "Auto-suggest" step showing predicted outcomes and an interactive slider to tune trade-offs. Provides PDF-ready commitment summary for legal/finance.

2) Throughput Commitment Handshake
   - Commitment Token: a signed document (opaque token) capturing agreed throughput bands, ramp schedule, and rollback conditions. Stored in the provisioning ledger and attached to the fleet allocation entry.
   - Approval Flow: optional auto-approval for small reservations; mandatory two-step approval for heavy commitments (Ops + Finance). Approver roles surfaced in Console and via webhook for SSO/SAML orgs.
   - Escrow & Penalties: outlines how burst credits are consumed and what qualifies as breach. Integrates with billing to surface overage warnings and enables configurable grace windows.

3) Simulation and Verification Engine
   - Replay historical traces against the selected APG policy to surface predicted utilization, p99/p95 token latency, and cost delta vs best-effort hosted.
   - Safety checks: flag policies that could starve other tenants on shared pools or violate internal fleet gating rules.

Acceptance criteria (must have):
- APG service generates valid policy presets for at least three workload archetypes and returns simulation metrics within 90s for a 30-day trace sample.
- Console onboarding wizard includes the Auto-suggest step and an approval CTA that kicks off the handshake flow.
- Commitment Token successfully stored in provisioning ledger and visible in Dedicated UI under "Reservation details."
- Approval flow supports configurable approvers and integrates with existing SSO groups.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement billing settlement logic for penalties (billing integration will be a follow-up).
- Not covering per-model quantization automation beyond recommending profiles.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (internal alpha): APG core and CLI simulation. Ship to two internal CSMs and capacity ops for validation (2 weeks).
- Phase 2 (external beta): Console wizard and handshake flow; pilot with 3 customers under sales concierge (4 weeks).
- Phase 3 (GA): wider release with metrics dashboard and opt-in migration for existing reservations (6 weeks).

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: APG suggestions could under-provision and cause SLA breaches. Mitigation: default "safe floor" on min_reserved_units and require ops sign-off for high-risk policies.
- Risk: Legal disputes over handshake wording. Mitigation: provide a non-legal summary and an exportable PDF and mark the token as "operational commitment" vs contract amendment.
